name: unicoemultiplo-theme
description: Unico e Multiplo Shopify theme (Dawn-based) — local development tooling

scripts.dev: npm run shopify -- theme dev -e production
scripts.dev:sync: npm run shopify -- theme dev -e production --theme-editor-sync
scripts.dev:open: npm run shopify -- theme dev -e production --open
scripts.preview: npm run shopify -- theme share -e production
scripts.push: npm run shopify -- theme push -e production --unpublished
scripts.pull: npm run shopify -- theme pull -e production
scripts.pull:settings: npm run shopify -- theme pull -e production --only config --only templates
scripts.themes: npm run shopify -- theme list -e production
